findings.summary: Whole-surface sweep: the source search found wall-clock request deadlines only in this module, in five tests beyond the two the manager named (test_generation_timeout_cannot_retry, test_slow_credential_returns_by_deadline_and_never_starts_late_post, test_abandoned_work_retains_slot_until_real_completion). All are covered by the shared helper; the control harness shows main's versions failing under load.

Two timing constructs could not take the helper unchanged: the generation test's 70 ms transport sleep and the slow-credential test's 0.8 s elapsed bound. Both were replaced by event-ordered checks of the same property, with no assertion dropped.
The helper's internal waits are 2 s safety bounds, matching the tests' existing release.wait(2). They only cap a regression's failure time and never decide a passing outcome.
